source_inputs: Public anchor positions used only as an exclusion mask for future non-anchor targets
discovery_inputs: Compute same-letter shifted ciphertext matches for periods 1..=20
Predeclare the 3 periods with the most shifted matches; tie-break by non-anchor endpoint coverage, then lower period
Score only non-anchor endpoints of those shifted same-letter pairs
No candidate words, routes, plaintext claims, or public-anchor additive fragments
prediction_target: Future source-backed non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in endpoints of predeclared ciphertext-only same-letter period matches before any candidate-word or public-anchor-derived tuning is performed.
controls: source-backed observation file required before scoring
public anchor positions excluded from period-match endpoint target positions
seeded same-size non-anchor position-shuffle baseline required
multiple-comparison context across all preregistered independent lanes required before interpretation
promotion blocked unless future independent observations beat controls without post-hoc retuning
note: Ciphertext period-match prior is a planning artifact for future independent observations; it is not a claimed solution, key, route, plaintext, or promotion criterion.
